items.name: Derivation.leibniz_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring A]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Module A M] [inst_5 : Module R M] (D : Derivation R A M)
  (a : A) (n : ℕ), D (a ^ n) = n • a ^ (n - 1) • D a

items.name: DividedPowers.mul_dpow
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring A] {I : Ideal A} (self : DividedPowers I) {m n : ℕ} {x : A},
  x ∈ I → self.dpow m x * self.dpow n x = ↑((m + n).choose m) * self.dpow (m + n) x

items.name: DividedPowers.prod_dpow
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring A] {I : Ideal A} {a : A} (hI : DividedPowers I) {ι : Type u_2} {s : Finset ι}
  {n : ι → ℕ}, a ∈ I → ∏ i ∈ s, hI.dpow (n i) a = ↑(Nat.multinomial s n) * hI.dpow (s.sum n) a

items.name: Differential.coeff_mapCoeffs
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Differential A] (p : Polynomial A) (i : ℕ),
  (Differential.mapCoeffs p).coeff i = (p.coeff i)′

items.name: PowerSeries.coeff_divXPowOrder
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {f : PowerSeries R} {n : ℕ},
  (PowerSeries.coeff n) f.divXPowOrder = (PowerSeries.coeff (n + f.order.toNat)) f
